desc: Ideation: single weighted DSU over full Z masks (handles all 30 bits at once); per-component minority-bit choice minimizes sum; self-loops only cause inconsistency.
Implement weighted DSU (parent, xor-to-parent as full integer mask) with iterative find + path compression and union by size/rank.
Parse input fast (buffered read, map to ints).
Process edges: skip self-loops with Z=0; if self-loop Z≠0 → print -1 and exit; otherwise union with mask Z, detecting contradiction → -1.
After unions, run find on every vertex that appears in any edge; group vertices by root (dict of lists), storing (vertex, mask).
Per component: count per-bit ones across masks (loop over set bits or 30-bit loop); choose root value r per bit to minimize ones; assign A_v = mask ⊕ r.
Print A_1..A_N space-separated (zeros for unconstrained vertices).
Verify the implementation against all three samples and edge cases (M=0, self-loops, conflicting duplicates, tie-breaking), checking the find path-compression xor logic carefully.
